classification: removes a markup span whose content is UNCONSTRAINED by the pattern
what_changes: the well-formed-pair pattern's `.*?` is not anchored to its OWN opening tag's matching close: starting from an ORPHAN opening tag (no bracket-closed form), it spans forward to the NEXT region's closing tag, deleting every printed character between them -- including a money token that was never inside any tag at all
what_does_not_change: text after the last det-tag construct
semantics_note: the model's own docstring for this function says it emits unclosed tags around footers, and two regions on one un-newlined line is exactly this shape -- not exotic. This is the second, independent counterexample to the row's original absolute claim (MAJOR-1)
